projects.name: P1
projects.compose:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:alpine
    ports:
      - "80:80"
    depends_on:
      - api

  api:
    image: node:18-alpine
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgres://db:5432/app
    depends_on:
      - db

  db:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=secret
      - POSTGRES_DB=app
    volumes:
      - db_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data

volumes:
  db_data:
